Sea State Explorer › Locations

Sea state by location

85 named offshore working areas, grouped by region. Each page gives the percentage of time significant wave height exceeds 1 to 4 m by calendar month, the mean wave height, wind and weather windows where the data carries them, the data point used, and a citation line. The figure beside each name is the share of the year with significant wave height above 2 m.

Data basis: ERA5 reanalysis (ECMWF / Copernicus C3S), 2010-2024, 3 hourly, 0.5° grid, nearest cell to each named position. For any other point use the explorer; how the numbers are made is in the methodology.

Values are long term climatological estimates for open water derived from reanalysis data. They are not forecasts, may underestimate extreme conditions including tropical cyclones, and are unreliable close to coastlines and in sheltered or shallow water. Not for design, navigation or operational decision making. No warranty is given.

Free to use for individual planning reference, and free to cite: Thrust Maritime, Sea State Explorer, the location and the date you read it, with a link to the result. Automated bulk extraction of the tool's data tiles is not permitted; the underlying open datasets are available from the original providers credited below, and the methodology page states every source and derivation.

Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information [2010-2024]. ERA5 hourly data on single levels (significant height of combined wind waves and swell). Neither the European Commission nor ECMWF is responsible for any use of this information.
